info.title: Fleetboard service API
info.description: Read the fleet (hosts, health, thresholds, disk forecasts, history, client audit, activity) and make a few audited changes. Every route except this description needs `Authorization: Bearer fbt_…`, a service token made with `fleetboard-server token add`. A read token may only read; changes need an act token. Lists are {total, rows}; units are in field names; times are UTC ISO.

reason.description: Why; written to the audit log

get.description: The token's name and whether it may read and act.
Hosts up/down/paused/silent, the five busiest hosts by CPU, the five fullest disks, every host's current issues and the thresholds in use.
One lean row per host: status, silent, last_seen, data_age_s, client_version, schema, cpu_pct, mem_pct, fullest disk, hottest_c, issue count.

parameters.name: silent_minutes
parameters.description: Silent after this many minutes (default: the offline_minutes threshold)

post.description: Action (act token). Adds a host after checking that it answers with the shared client token.

get.description: One host in full: facts, CPU, memory, each disk, GPU and sensor, the busiest interfaces, listen address, binary SHA-256 and its issues.
Every disk, memory and temperature over a limit right now, and hosts silent longer than offline_minutes. Limits default to the stored thresholds.
Per disk: used_pct, growth_bytes_per_day (least squares over daily averages, or hourly ones while history is short) and full_in_days / full_by.

parameters.name: host
parameters.description: Only this host (id, name or hostname)

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Days of history the trend uses

parameters.name: within_days
parameters.description: Only disks expected to fill within this many days

get.description: One metric of one host as min/avg/max per interval: 10-second data for cpu/mem/load up to 24 h, hourly rollups up to 7 days (hours), daily rollups up to 90 days (days).

parameters.name: metric
parameters.description: cpu, mem, load, temp, disk[:<mount>], net[:<interface>] or gpu[:<n>]

404.description: no such host or no history for that metric

get.description: Per host: client_version, schema, listen address, binary_sha256, and flags (listens on every address, binary differs from the other hosts on the same version and platform, older than the newest client).
The audit log, newest first: hosts added, changed, paused, removed, thresholds set, refused actions.

parameters.name: host
parameters.description: Only entries about this host name

get.description: The limits in use (disk_pct, disk_critical_pct, mem_pct, temp_c, offline_minutes) with defaults and ranges.

post.description: Action (act token). Change one limit; used by the audit operations and the Wazuh disk and offline alerts.
Action (act token). Stop polling and alerting on a host; history stays.
Action (act token). The host must answer first.
Action (act token). Removes the host and all its history; can't be undone.
